2026-10-23 receive investigation and controlled workaround. Group15 old-base 589a7bea and fresh origin/main-base 63681d4a each passed the full local gate (19,712 passed, 93 skipped) but review pushes rejected before change creation with Missing tree 37cf50101b30d7d6cf08f391ad13144ee2fd3183. Gerrit error_log records the fresh rejection at 22:44:36 UTC in JGit FullConnectivityChecker.checkObjects:196. Fetched Gerrit main a74d0073 contains that historical tests tree; it is absent from 63681d4a's outgoing object set. Inside compose-gerrit-1 as uid 1000, cat-file returns tree and full fsck --full --connectivity-only --no-dangling --strict exits 0 (SSM command 74d96904-9a2e-46a1-82b3-03a33f5af4a9). A Gerrit REST historical-file read also returned HTTP 200. These observations reject a physically missing object as the explanation for this occurrence.

Git 2.56 trace of git push --dry-run --no-thin over the configured HTTPS remote invokes git send-pack --thin; Git remote-curl.c defaults thin=1 and does not expose a thin option. JGit FullConnectivityChecker.java:191-197 tests PackParser.getBaseObjectIds() for reachability; PackParser defines those as external delta bases assumed by the incoming pack. A local pack of the exact 63681d4a outgoing set with ordinary --thin had 49 unresolved REF_DELTA bases. With git -c pack.window=0 -c pack.depth=0 pack-objects --revs --thin, all 52 outgoing objects were non-delta and the pack indexed/verified self-contained. One authorized unchanged-SHA review push with those client pack settings succeeded as Gerrit 3084 patchset 1, exact revision 63681d4aff06ecedbbee46a3c66ea00960f75f4a; CI run 40036743748 started. No Gerrit object-store mutation or restart occurred. The exact reason JGit did not mark tree 37cf reachable remains unproven. Ordinary/default push health remains unverified; keep this bug open. Evidence trace: /Users/joeoakhart/scratch/g15-pack0-push-20261023-8r05g9/ (local only).
